schema.description: A vetter asks the community to deliver their live vetter role credential again, over credential-exchange/issue, and an administrator may do the same on a named member's behalf. The community issues nothing new and returns the delivered credential's `id` and `validUntil`.

memberDid.description: The vetter to resend the live grant for, on an administrator's behalf. Requires the community-administrator capability. Absent: the request concerns the sender's own live grant, exactly as 0.1.
